title: The Hamburg MapTask Corpus (HAMATAC)
annotation_target: orthographic transcription; disfluencies; phonetic phenomena; POS/lemma
manual_scope: Repository states manual orthographic transcription, manual disfluency annotation, and manual annotation of phonetic phenomena; current version additionally has manually corrected POS/lemmas
decision_reason: Strong primary non-singing production candidate, but repository access is restricted and the exact reusable phonetic-phenomena annotation files/rights require direct enumeration before core admission.
evidence_summary: 24 L2-German map-task recordings from a purpose-built project corpus; repository metadata reports manual transcription and manual phonetic-phenomena/disfluency annotation. Keep out of core until restricted files and annotation granularity can be inspected.
